description: This file contains pytest-based asynchronous test cases for the DynamoAIGuardrails class, specifically testing its behavior with different API response scenarios to enforce guardrails in content moderation.

classes.name: DynamoAIGuardrails
classes.description: A guardrail class responsible for interfacing with DynamoAI to enforce content policies.

methods.name: test_dynamoai_blocks_content_with_block_action()
methods.description: Tests that the DynamoAIGuardrails correctly blocks content when the API responds with a BLOCK action.

methods.name: test_dynamoai_allows_content_with_none_action()
methods.description: Tests that the DynamoAIGuardrails allows content to pass through when the API responds with a NONE action.
